record.question: Which one of the following is not consistent with incidence of loss of Measurement Books?
options: Report of the facts should be made immediately to the Chief Engineer / ADG / SDG.
In case of theft or loss of blank Measurement Book, the Superintending Engineer / Chief Engineer is the competent authority to write off.
The measurements in the lost Measurement Book should be re-constructed at the earliest.
FIR should be lodged with the police only after the lost Measurement Book has been written off.
record.explanation: FIR should be lodged immediately, not after write-off.
